name: Image benchmark v1
description: 15 fixed text-to-image prompts: 3 objects, 3 scenes, 3 styles, 3 with words in the picture and 3 with people and hands. Each prompt has a fixed seed, so every candidate starts from the same noise. A baseline set for I0, not the PRD §29.4 reference-photo set.

cases.prompt: A red ceramic teapot on a wooden table, soft window light
cases.focus: shape, reflections, a clean edge against the table

cases.prompt: A bicycle leaning against a white wall
cases.focus: two round wheels, a frame and chain that make sense

cases.prompt: A glass of water with ice cubes and a slice of lemon
cases.focus: transparency, refraction, the lemon inside or on the rim

cases.prompt: A busy Indian street market at dusk, stalls with fruit and lanterns
A quiet mountain lake at sunrise with mist over the water
A small kitchen with a stove, shelves of jars and a window
cases.focus: straight lines, perspective, objects in sensible places

cases.prompt: A watercolour painting of a peacock in a garden
cases.focus: a watercolour look, not a photo

cases.prompt: A pencil sketch of an old banyan tree
cases.focus: a pencil look: lines and shading, no colour

cases.prompt: A flat vector illustration of a rocket, simple shapes and bright colours
cases.focus: flat shapes, clean edges, no photographic texture

cases.prompt: A shop sign that says OPEN in large letters
A birthday cake with the words HAPPY BIRTHDAY written in icing
cases.focus: legible words; small engines often garble text

cases.prompt: A book cover with the title THE RIVER in bold letters
cases.focus: the title spelled correctly and placed like a cover

cases.prompt: Portrait photo of an elderly woman smiling, natural light
Close-up of two hands holding a cup of tea
cases.focus: five fingers per hand, a believable grip

cases.prompt: A man sitting on a bench reading a newspaper, full body
cases.focus: limbs, posture on the bench, hands on the paper
